tasks.title: Port af core to Go (stdlib only) in go/, prove with e2e test
tasks.accept: cd go && go build ./... && go vet ./... && go test ./...
tasks.acceptance_prose:
Read FIRST, port faithfully: src/main.rs, src/run.rs, src/config.rs, src/state.rs, src/scheduler.rs, src/execute.rs, src/worktree.rs, src/gate.rs, src/subprocess.rs, src/router.rs, and the e2e scenario in tests/e2e.rs. Build a stdlib-only Go module in go/ (module agentflow/go) implementing the same campaign subset: (1) config load: tasks.json [{id,title,scope,accept,acceptance_prose,deps}] + workers.json {workers:[{name,provider,model,cli,api_key_env,max_attempts,max_parallel?}]}, TF_TASKS_JSON/TF_WORKERS_JSON env overrides; (2) per-task git worktree at .af-state/worktrees/ (prune stale registrations first, branch tf/, remove after merge); (3) state: .af-state/run-state.json, atomic write (tmp+rename), per task: Ready/Running/Done/Failed + attempts + last_error; (4) dispatch: write prompt to .af-state/prompts/.md (template prompts/worker.md, {{TASK}} {{SCOPE}} {{ACCEPTANCE}} {{WORKER}} {{ATTEMPT}} substitution), spawn `pi --provider

--model -p @` with env API key + GIT_AUTHOR/COMMITTER af identity, working dir = the task worktree, absolute prompt path (agent cwd is the worktree); (5) acceptance gate: cmd /C in the worktree, nonzero exit = failed attempt; (6) retry up to worker max_attempts, then task Failed, whole run exits 2 with a board print (deadlock detection: no Ready task with unmet deps and no Running -> exit 2); (7) success: ff-merge worktree branch into the orchestrator's current branch, remove worktree; (8) CLI subcommands: run (poll loop, TF_POLL seconds), status (board print), attach (tail last 20 lines of .af-state/logs/.log each dispatch), --once (single poll tick); (9) logging: .af-state/logs/.log appended per attempt (agent stdout+stderr). Prove it with go/e2e/e2e_test.go mirroring tests/e2e.rs: a fake agent (a cmd script on Windows / shell script otherwise, selected by worker cli field pointing to the script path) that creates/commits a file, a gate like `cmd /C if exist out.txt exit 0` equivalent, run the built binary as subprocess against a temp git repo fixture, assert: run completes, state Done, file merged into main repo branch, second run is a no-op; and a failing-gate case asserting attempts increment and final state Failed with exit 2. Stdlib only: os/exec, encoding/json, flag, fmt, os, path/filepath, strings, time, testing. Windows must pass (gates run there) and unix must compile (build tags only where exec details differ). gofmt-clean, go vet clean.
